C08-M11-L01-F1.title: An auditable SOC intake workflow
C08-M11-L01-F1.caption: A stable source key and linked case record carry the alert from receipt to any separately authorised action.
C08-M11-L01-F1.alt: Six ordered steps show receipt, validation and stable event identity, internal context, creating or linking a case, human approval where needed, and verification of the resulting effect.

steps.label: Receive the alert
steps.sub: Record the source and event ID

steps.label: Validate and deduplicate
steps.sub: Check required fields and stable identity

steps.label: Create or link a case
steps.sub: Preserve the source and workflow references

steps.label: Record and verify the outcome
steps.sub: Keep unknown effects open for review

C08-M11-L01-F1.note: Linked records make the decision and its outcome reviewable.
